title: Es war einmal in Ost-Berlin
tagline: A point-and-click museum of growing up in 1980s East Berlin and 1990s Berlin: 8 places, 73 things to find, and a question for mum or dad on every card.
readinessNote: Every place and every thing is a data entry in js/rooms-*.js (position, drawing, German name, English, text, question), and every photo and film is one line in js/media.js. You can add things, cards and photos without touching the engine. A new place on the street needs a drawing in js/hub.js too.
buildYourOwn: Your own museum: another city, another decade, your own family's childhood. New things, TV channels, records, dishes, photos and film clips.
controls: One left click for everything: mouse, touch, or a TV pointer remote (LG Magic Remote). No keys, no dragging.
